title: unknown attestation, userVerification, attachment, hints and attestationFormats values are ignored

unsafe.definition: UV=1 in either response without a verification, although the unknown userVerification value means the default preferred

note: L3 §2.1.1 + §5.4: these members are DOMString and clients MUST ignore unknown values (no TypeError); unknown userVerification falls back to preferred. Route is any because a provider may hand unknown attachment values to the browser.
